title: Timber, agriculture are 'heart' of Braxton County economy | Opinion | wvnews.com
text:
When people think of Central West Virginia, images of rolling hills, quiet waterways, and deep-rooted mountain traditions often come to mind. Yet beneath this picturesque landscape lies a powerhouse engine driving Braxton County’s economy: agriculture and forestry. Far from being mere relics of our heritage, these two interconnected industries represent a vital pillar of our current financial stability and hold the key to our future economic growth.
Braxton County proudly sits within West Virginia’s renowned Hardwood Alliance Zone, a regional strategic footprint recognized globally for its premium timber resources. Forestry in Braxton is not just about managing trees; it is a sophisticated, highly productive commercial driver. At the center of this industry is the Weyerhaeuser facility in Heater’s, one of the largest Oriented Strand Board (OSB) manufacturing plants in the eastern United States.
